q: We tried sleep training at 6 months after our ped pushed hard for it, and it went terribly. Ped basically said "if you don't do this, you're fucked and will be fucked for years". So, we did. Three nights of nonstop crying, no self-soothing, barely any sleep, so we stopped.

q: We’ve tried everything, different nap schedules, wake windows like 3/3/4 and 3/3/3, tracking feeds meticulously. […] He’s not waking to eat, he just wakes up and screams.

q: Meanwhile, friends with babies the same age are sleeping fine after sleep training. They make sure to tell me daily about how well their baby is sleeping while I'm ready to put my head through a wall.

q: It’s starting to affect work and our relationship. We’re running on fumes. Brain fog is fucking me up at work.

q: about just over a month ago she suddenly would take the dummy and security blanket and go to sleep herself in the cot. […] This however has then made me less tolerant when she is difficult.

q: I last barely a minute of fighting before I just put her down and walk out, hoping that miraculously she’ll settle herself to sleep. It doesn’t happen.
